name: V-INDEX / Rolewisp — Source-Backed Job Data Platform
summary: Platform-specific job collectors with shared normalization, source provenance, searchable indexing, and private Candidate / Employer workspaces.
highlights: 71/78 target platforms (91.0%) had native source coverage; seven requirements remained unmet. This is coverage, not project completion or reliability.
9,187 indexed jobs at the 21 November 2026 review; 130/142 registered sources had an initial successful collection. Dated snapshot, not a live count.
Conservative closure requires two complete-enumeration misses at least 24 hours apart; final backend cleanup run reported 1,269 passing tests and one skip.

evidence.claim: Delivered native job-source coverage across 71 of 78 target platforms (91.0%), by implementing platform-specific collectors, shared normalization, provenance tracking, and independently live-verified examples.
evidence.scope: Seven platform requirements remained unmet; 91.0% is platform coverage, not project completion or reliability.

evidence.claim: Built a searchable hosted index containing 9,187 jobs at the 21 November review, by running a persistent indexing worker across 142 registered sources, 130 of which had completed an initial successful collection.
evidence.scope: Dated snapshot, not a current live count or a sustained-throughput result; 12 sources still lacked initial success.

evidence.claim: Implemented conservative job-closure handling requiring two complete-enumeration misses at least 24 hours apart, by retaining source observations and rejecting incomplete batches before index mutation.
evidence.scope: Closure-policy scope; no measured false-closure reduction is claimed.

evidence.claim: Verified recoverability of all 16 database tables with matching row counts in a recorded restore drill, by restoring a 42,387,200-byte encrypted production snapshot into an isolated PostgreSQL instance.
evidence.scope: The drill did not mutate production; independent recovery-key custody and deletion reconciliation were still open.

evidence.claim: Delivered private workspaces for two account roles, Candidate and Employer, by implementing ownership checks, protected profile/resume operations, hashed session tokens, and Redis-backed credential rate limits.
evidence.scope: Hosted ownership checks are documented; live email/OAuth provider activation remained a separate gate.

evidence.claim: Established regression coverage with 1,269 passing backend tests and one skip in the final recorded cleanup run, by testing source collectors, lifecycle rules, account isolation, and PostgreSQL/Redis integrations.
evidence.scope: Final cleanup revision; earlier totals of 1,244, 1,249, and 1,272 refer to different revisions and must not be added together.

name: Data Pipeline Immune System — Multi-Agent Data Reliability
summary: A six-agent recovery workflow separating detection, diagnosis, risk assessment, remediation, verification, and learning, with explicit policies and human-escalation gates.
highlights: Four simulated failure types: timeouts, corrupted records, volume drops, and additive schema drift. Scenario coverage, not production incidents resolved.
Bronze/Silver PySpark jobs for five domain families: orders, customers, payments, inventory, and shipments.
Five-factor health scoring and configured reporting cadences. Diagnosis is currently heuristic, not a verified live LLM integration; no universal recovery rate or achieved SLA is claimed.

evidence.claim: Delivered a six-agent pipeline-recovery workflow, by separating detection, diagnosis, risk assessment, remediation, verification, and learning behind explicit action policies and human-escalation gates.
evidence.scope: Agent count measures implemented responsibilities; the current diagnosis client is heuristic, not a verified live LLM integration.

evidence.claim: Added recovery-scenario coverage for four failure types, by injecting timeouts, corrupted records, volume drops, and additive schema drift into a controlled simulation harness with quarantine and verification paths.
evidence.scope: Scenario coverage, not proof of four production incidents resolved or a universal recovery-success rate.

evidence.claim: Added Bronze/Silver processing jobs for five business domains, by implementing PySpark ingestion and transformation modules for orders, customers, payments, inventory, and shipments.
evidence.scope: Five domain families are present in the codebase; this is not a measured processed-row count.

evidence.claim: Implemented a five-factor pipeline-health score, by combining reliability, freshness, data quality, schema stability, and SLA compliance into a weighted operational indicator.
evidence.scope: The factors are weighted 30%, 20%, 20%, 15%, and 15%; the formula does not establish achieved SLA compliance.

evidence.claim: Added two operational notification cadences, hourly Telegram summaries and six-hour email briefings, by implementing a reporting daemon and timeout/retry handling for external notification and BigQuery calls.
evidence.scope: Configured schedules and error-handling work; no measured alert-delivery or downtime improvement is claimed.
